W.note: Polished and feature-rich with a pleasing peel, but the body is a rounded egg with only a tiny nub that appears from some angles, so it reads as a melon or yellow ball more than a lemon.

X.note: Clearly a lemon with a pointed stem end, dimpled peel, warm highlight, leaf and stem, and a smooth turn; the stem end is clipped off at the canvas edge on desktop and mobile, but it is still the best lemon.

Y.note: Tall, capsule-shaped body with harsh speckled pits and no pointed nub, so it looks more like a pickle or corn cob than a lemon, and the leaf placement is odd.

Z.note: A glittery, over-noisy egg with no stem nub, cluttered by overlay panels that cover the model on phone.
